items.title: Medical physics: introduction (taaruf) aur istemal hone wali radiations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter 20 opening text and the radiations used in medical physics (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Medical physics physics ki woh branch (shakh) hai jo physics ke principles (usool) aur techniques (tareeqe) medicine (ilaj) mein istemal karti hai, khaas taur par bimariyon ki diagnosis (pehchan) aur treatment (ilaj) mein. Yeh physics ke knowledge (ilm) ko medical science se jor kar nayi technologies banati aur chalati hai. In se doctors insani body (jism) ke andar dekh sakte hain aur mareezon ka safe (mehfooz) aur achha ilaj kar sakte hain. Medical physics medical imaging ko zyada accurate (durust) banati hai, radiation ke risk (khatre) kam karti hai aur ilaj ke tareeqe behtar karti hai. Hospitals aur diagnostic centers mein X-ray imaging, ultrasound scans, CT-scans aur PET-scans isi ki misalein hain. In se doctors bina surgery (operation) ke fracture (haddi ka tootna) pakarte hain, tumour (rasoli) ki pehchan karte hain aur andar ke organs (aza) dekhte hain. Is tarah medical physics jaldi diagnosis, achhe ilaj aur behtar zindagi mein madad deti hai. Is chapter mein hum parhenge ke physics ke principles se advanced (jadeed) imaging techniques kaise banti hain: PET positron–electron annihilation (positron aur electron ka mil kar khatam ho jana) aur gamma-ray detection (pakarna) se kaise kaam karta hai, piezoelectric effect ultrasound waves banane aur pakarne mein kya kaam karta hai, aur X-rays kaise banti aur istemal hoti hain.
